### DHI Group, Inc. to Participate in the LD Micro Invitational XVI Investor Conference on May 18, 2026


May 12, 2026


CENTENNIAL, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX) announced today that it will participate in the LD Micro Main Event Investor Conference on May 18, 2026. Art Zeile, Chief Executive Officer, is scheduled to present on Monday, May 18th, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time, and will also host one-on-one meetings with investors throughout the day. The conference takes place May 18-19, 2026, at the Luxe Sunset Blvd Hotel in Los Angeles, CA.


A webcast of the presentation will be available on the DHI Group investor relations website at[https://dhigroupinc.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54534808&newsitemid=20260512691727&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Finvestors&index=1&md5=db7ac4e4c5595a0a561cc0e384838d63) . An audio recording of the presentation will be archived and available following the event.


To schedule a one-on-one meeting or for more information, please contact the DHI Group’s investor relations firm, PondelWilkinson, atir@dhigroupinc.com .


**About DHI Group, Inc.**


[DHI Group, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54534808&newsitemid=20260512691727&lan=en-US&anchor=DHI+Group%2C+Inc.&index=2&md5=2d47ec0e6a9108451bff9035bf24fff9) (NYSE: DHX) is a provider of AI-powered career marketplaces that focus on technology roles. DHI’s two brands, Dice and ClearanceJobs, enable recruiters and hiring managers to efficiently search for and connect with highly skilled technology professionals based on the skills requested. The Company’s patented algorithm manages over 100,000 unique technology skills. Additionally, our marketplaces allow tech professionals to find their ideal next career opportunity, with relevant advice and personalized insights. Learn more at[www.dhigroupinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54534808&newsitemid=20260512691727&lan=en-US&anchor=www.dhigroupinc.com&index=3&md5=5b775cac7540857845ce491152e6e77f) .
